The company is pouring money and resources into AI with the goal of reshaping virtually every part of its ecosystem. And instead of making users learn yet another platform, Meta is putting AI directly into the apps they already use. Meta AI is available across WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, and Messenger, helping people answer questions, create content, search for information, get recommendations, and handle everyday tasks without ever leaving the app. Story Continues Now, Meta is taking that strategy a step further. Earlier this week, the company unveiled its AI personal agent app, a move that immediately caught Wall Street's attention and sent Meta shares soaring nearly 6.6% on Sept. 9.
